title: Elysium
description: This projects add Elysium to Minecraft, an alloy of copper and netherite.
body:
Elysium is small, quaint mod inspired by Diansu's Elysium mod. It was aimed to make a somewhat Vanilla Minecraft feeling drop, without overshadowing everything that base Minecraft has to offer.

![Everything inside of the Elysium Mod, including the batteries, Elysium, Chierosiphon, the dagger, and more](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd936d50ac0860f8e3b731b84f1b51e0fc2abfde.png)

 It contains the following:

- Elysium - An alloy created by combining netherite scrap and copper. It is the base material used for nearly everything else in the mod.

- New Elysium Blocks - In Elysium, there are multiple new blocks you can create with elysium, like the Electrode and the Repulsor. These blocks are the Conductor, a simple to use lightning summoner, the Electrode, which is a strengthed version of the Conductor, and the Repulsors and Gravitators, which push the player back with varied amounts of strength. A lot of these blocks have unintended unique functionality, so experiment and see what you can do! 

![An Elysium Dagger on an Electrode in a Desert Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8515a4c7d5ee643dfc15caa7c8f3d14fa1595c6.png)
![The aftermath of using a Conductor.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ba252c5102cc8a48e26a734e663a2d88cbd4a79.png)
![The three batteries added in Elysium, with low producing a signal of 4, medium a signal of 9, and high with a signal of 15, all via a comparator.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60aa450d0e0a2a7b9176417bbf4aa6a99c520b6b.png)

- Weapons & Tools - Multiple weapons exist, including the Elysium Dagger, the Cheirosiphon, and the Elysium Prism. These are a small set of weapons, but very powerful. Some grant effects like Voltage, which more information can be granted in the next bullet point.

- New Effects & Enchants - Elysium introduces new effects into the world of Minecraft, like Voltage or Enchanted, which summons lightning and boost XP respectively. There is also new enchantments, like Gasoline or Jet, which creates explosive fireballs or boosts reach respectively.

![Weakness, alongside the two new Elysium effects: Voltage and Enchanted, with Voltage II text on screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d147877a283aa5324527311632dfb9aa80e82aa5.png)

- Advancements - Elysium includes 9 advancements to get while playing in survival, including the following:

- First Contact
- Conduction
- Conduction, But Better
- Over-Over Enchanting
- Overcharged
- True Elysium
- Combustion
- Well, That Was Dumb
- Gravitation

![The advancement tree for Elysium after getting the advancement "First Contact" and not including challenges](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54c7328ec7f2f8a093a1f39d87c7bfacdd3a3799.png)

Elysium supports 1.21.8 NeoForge Java Edition. It uses both client-side and server-side support, but doesn't have any dependencies. I hope you enjoy playing with Elysium, if you choose to download the mod.
